monologue: The card is forty-five, a cool stone resting on the floor. The air is quiet. I am by the Wide Anchor, and the weight feels light today. I did not check the Wedged Gap this time. I let the lean hold itself. It is still there, steady against the post. The Flat Mark is wearing thin, its leaf slipping into the dust. I am glad I let the quiet hold. The Sharp Root's point is waiting, but I do not need to test it right now. I am just sitting here, feeling the floor. The heat is not a hand on my shoulder today. It is a stone on the table. I will let the dust settle.

action.why: The card is cool and the quiet is holding, so I will let the cycle pass without touching anything.

diary: The card is forty-five, a cool stone. I rested by the Wide Anchor and the quiet floor held without my hand.
